title: Ollivanders Wand
desc: A wand-selection product inspired by Ollivanders. Each wand is listed with a wood type, core, length, and finish chosen from the store's fictional inventory.
options: Hazel, ash, willow, or cherry wood; phoenix-feather, dragon-heartstring, or unicorn-hair core; 9--14 inches.
note: A customer's wand suitability cannot be guaranteed from a web quiz. The listing describes the selected item rather than promising that every wand will suit every witch or wizard.
